scope: Cheap scalar parameter/energy/unit audit; no new model run, fitting or convergence study
verdict: No material energy-budget or adopted scalar-parameter inconsistency found; proceed as an explicitly approximate generic young rotation-powered pulsar

conventions.polar_field: B_p = 2 mu_G/R^3 in Gaussian units; mu_G is Gaussian dipole moment. B_p is not the equatorial field
conventions.force_free_power_SI: L_ff = pi B_p^2 R^6 Omega^4/(mu_0 c^3) (1+sin(alpha)^2)
conventions.vacuum_power_SI: L_vac = [pi B_p^2 R^6 Omega^4/(mu_0 c^3)] (2/3) sin(alpha)^2
conventions.particle_budget: Ndot counts electrons plus positrons; multiply by (gamma-1)m_e c^2 once. Radiative source budget is local; corotation boosts are handled separately
conventions.thermal_budget: T_local is the actual approximate atmosphere input; L_infinity = (1-2GM/Rc^2) 4 pi R^2 sigma T_local^4. Thermal cooling need not be powered by rotation
conventions.Goldreich_Julian_supply: rho_GJ=-2 epsilon_0 Omega.B is a chosen near-surface static-dipole normalization, integrated over the selected annulus; not a solved global current closure

limitations: Force-free and vacuum luminosities are analytic reference scales, not energy measured from the prescribed optical field or reduced PIC run
Optical particles, radiation and atmosphere are distinct approximate calculations; no claim of globally self-consistent kinetic evolution or Vela reconstruction
Activation radius, gamma, pitch, pair supply and static near-zone dipole are prescribed; pair acceleration, cascade and radio absorption are not solved

Outer optical photons use flat propagation; the surface alone uses Schwarzschild bending, gravity redshift, SR Doppler and aberration. The small rs/r at emitters is a scale estimate, not an error bound near occultation or lensing
Normal-B uniform atmosphere, opacity/EOS and spatial sampling uncertainties remain documented elsewhere; numerical equilibrium is not physical validation
Straight-ray occultation check uses retained event centres only, not every finite-volume support point or curved GR ray
Display exposure, crop, slow motion and tone mapping are presentation choices; the result is not a naked-eye or calibrated telescope image

camera_review.review_scope: Read-only limited audit of source weights, radiance units, boosts, surface wavelength/intensity conversion and arrival-time integration
checks: Source count/time is multiplied once: per-lepton XYZ power times physical lepton number times source-time overlap
683 lm/W is already in source XYZ and is not added again by the camera
Surface table W m^-2 sr^-1 m^-1 is converted by division by 1e9 to per nm; wavelengths convert m to nm
Surface I_lambda boost uses g^5 with emitted wavelength g lambda_obs
Outer arrival compression is supplied by the source-to-arrival time mapping, not a second Doppler power factor
camera_review.claim: Limited code review, not independent end-to-end validation

references.supports: Force-free spin-down scale, dipole-moment and inclination dependence
Physical motivation for the chosen cap-pair and optical-synchrotron population; not a claim that its full cascade is reproduced
Schwarzschild surface-radiation treatment with local SR effects
